profile.ja: サイボーグ強化された元米連所属兵。米連海軍特殊部隊を経て米連国務省系の特務機関“Ｇ”に所属していたが、五車に因われた後、内調の手によって解放され内調所属となる。全身の筋肉が特殊な金属繊維で強化されたサイボーグで、生身でありながら装甲車並の防御力とオーガを素手で殴り殺せるほどのパワーを有する。さらに内調で新たなサイボーグ手術を受け、さらなる力を手に入れていた。だが、『五車決戦』にてふうま災禍に敗北して以来、行方は知られていなかった。
profile.en: She is a cybernetically enhanced former member of the US military. She was part of the US Navy's special forces and later joined the "G" agency, which is affiliated with the US Department of State. After being affected by the Gosha, she was freed by the Internal Affairs department and now belongs to them. Her entire body has been reinforced with special metal fibers, giving her the defensive capabilities of an armored vehicle and the power to kill an Ogre with her bare hands. She has also undergone additional cybernetic enhancements in the Internal Affairs department, granting her even more strength. However, since her defeat at the hands of Fuuma Saika in the Gosha battle, her whereabouts have been unknown.

text.ja: アタシも色んな所に尻尾振ったけどよ、さすがにブチのめされた部隊相手には初めてだ。……まあ、せいぜい働くんでよろしく頼むぜ
text.en: I've worked with a lot of teams before, but this is the first time I've been with a group that's been thoroughly defeated. Well, I'll do my best, so take care of me, okay?

text.ja: こんな落ちぶれたアタシでもいいってんだから、本当に酔狂な野郎だぜ。しかも案外上手く使っちまうし、いい所に拾われたもんだ
text.en: You're really something else, taking in a fallen woman like me. And you're actually pretty good at using me, too. I guess I was lucky to have been picked up by you.

text.ja: あんたの部隊の協力料じゃ、今の所は体のメンテナンスで精いっぱいだな。武器の方は元に戻すまでもうちょっと時間がかかるぜ？
text.en: The cooperation fee for your team is just enough to cover my body's maintenance for now. As for my weapons, it'll take a bit more time to get them back to normal.

text.ja: 一度地獄を味わったんだ。今度は簡単に負けちまわない所につきたいもんだぜ。なあ、あんたはそれができるだろ？　頼むぜ？
text.en: I've been to hell once, and I don't want to lose that easily again. Can you help me with that? I'm counting on you.

text.ja: アタシを仲間にするのに、ずいぶん災禍からは反対されたみたいじゃねえか。良かったのかい？　ふぅん、まあ、悪い気はしねえな
text.en: It seems like there was a lot of opposition to you taking me in, especially from Fuuma Saika. Are you okay with that? Well, I don't mind, personally.

text.ja: やっぱ五車といったら稲毛屋のアイスだよなぁ。これだけでもあんたについた甲斐があったぜ。んーっ、うまいっ！
text.en: When it comes to the Gosha, you can't go wrong with Inaruya's ice cream. At least that's something I can enjoy while I'm with you. Mmm, it's delicious!

text.ja: 任務以外でのアタシの行動は別に自由だろ？　そんなに気になるなら首輪でもつけておけってんだ。…………なんだ？　つけねえのか？
text.en: I'm free to do what I want outside of missions, right? If you're that worried, you could always put a collar on me... or are you not going to?

text.ja: うわっ、ヌルヌルは勘弁してくれよ……あんたには教えといてやるが、アタシのサイボーグ筋繊維は錆に弱くてなぁ。ままならねぇぜ
text.en: Ugh, spare me the slippery stuff, okay? My cybernetic muscle fibers are weak against rust, so it's a real pain.

text.ja: はぁ、はぁっ、へっ、へっ、へ……ご主人っ、ごしゅじぃん、チンポおくれよぉ、ご褒美ちんぽぉ、くぅうん、頭撫でながら、ハメてぇ
text.en: Ah, ah, heh, heh, heh... Master, Master, give me your reward, your precious cock, I'm begging you... while you stroke my head, fuck me, please...

text.ja: おぉん、あおぉおんん、ご主人のチンポきぼちいぃ～～……おっ、おっ、おぉおぉ～～！！　服従するの、こんなに幸せなんてぇ……
text.en: Ah, ah, oh, oh, oh! Master's cock is so amazing...! Being obedient to you makes me so happy...

text.ja: こんなアタシの姿を見せるの、あんたの前だけだからな……はぁ、はぁ……絶対誰にも言うなよ……災禍には、特にだぜ？　くうぅん
text.en: I'm only showing you this side of me, so don't tell anyone, especially Fuuma Saika... got it? I'm only doing this because it's you...
